properties.value: ecdsa>=0.9 declared at requirements.txt:1 (and setup.py:16) — the pure-Python ECDSA library the build ships. The 0.9 floor is 2014-era (pre-dates constant-time hardening work in later releases; pure-Python bignums are inherently timing-leaky, acceptable here because the library verifies public firmware signatures rather than handling secrets). Provides the secp256k1 ECDSA verification in trezorlib/firmware.py and curve math for tests/support/ckd_public.py; algorithm usage is tracked under ALG-71
